title: iAm.md: Robot Skill Self-Assessment through Agentic Introspection for Unknown Open-Vocabulary Domains
abstract: arXiv:2610.10962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic AI based on Large Language Model generalization capabilities offers a wide range of potential applications, including planning for embodied tasks. For example, embodied agents based on Foundation models can generate plausible plans in autonomous robotics scenarios. Due to limited context windows or hallucinatory phenomena in the next-token prediction formulation, behaviors may be generated without establishing whether the deployed robot and the observed environment actually support the requested operation, in what we call a "grounding failure". Thanks to the recent improvements in reasoning capabilities of foundation models, autonomous robot behavior generation problem can be formulated as a code generation problem. We present iAm.md, a Markdown standard and generation framework, that allows anchoring this process in complementary forms of deployment evidence. translated_title: iAm.md：通过智能体内省实现对未知开放词汇领域的机器人技能自我评估
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型泛化能力的智能体AI（Agentic AI）提供了广泛的应用前景，包括具身任务的规划。例如，基于基础模型的具身智能体可以在自主机器人场景中生成看似合理的计划。然而，由于上下文窗口的限制或下一词元预测机制中的幻觉现象，系统可能会生成一些行为，却未确认所部署的机器人和观察到的环境是否真正支持所请求的操作，我们将这种现象称为“接地失败”（grounding failure）。得益于基础模型推理能力的近期进展，自主机器人行为生成问题可以被表述为一个代码生成问题。我们提出了iAm.md，一个Markdown标准与生成框架，允许将这一过程锚定在互补形式的部署证据之中。通过开放词汇语义映射，我们结合了局部视觉……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出iAm.md——一个Markdown标准与生成框架，通过智能体内省和开放词汇语义映射等部署证据，使机器人能在未知开放词汇环境中自我评估技能可行性，从而避免基础模型规划中的“接地失败”问题。
en_tdlr: iAm.md is a Markdown standard and generation framework that enables robot skill self-assessment through agentic introspection and open-vocabulary semantic mapping, anchoring behavior generation in deployment evidence to prevent grounding failures in unknown open-vocabulary domains.
